parameters.content:
## Media resources for a production decision
Find saved code, workflows and references for subtitle timing and video finishing. The output preserves source evidence and rights; it does not generate an answer or media.

**Try it:** import this JSON, open Example media question and run Try the example. No Veyrul login or API key is required for this public lookup. Your existing n8n hosting costs remain yours.

Only put a non-confidential media question in `query`. Do not paste private briefs, credentials or customer assets.

## Reuse on relevant tasks
Save this workflow, then call it with Execute Sub-workflow or Call n8n Workflow Tool. Pass `query` (1–500 characters), optionally `previous_record_ids` from a prior packet. The caller should decide when a lookup is useful.

For a later related task, keep `remember_record_ids` in your own workflow and pass them back. Returned IDs are labelled reused or newly returned; this is not a change feed or evidence of real adoption. Previous IDs are not sent to Veyrul.

## What the next step receives
`resources_found`: inspect relevance, evidence, versions and rights. A search match is not an approved production recommendation.
`no_matches`: refine the question or continue research.
`lookup_failed` / `invalid_response`: no usable lookup; the caller decides whether to retry later.
`invalid_input`: no HTTP call was made.

One GET per valid input item. No automatic retries, schedules, model calls, media downloads or code execution. Preserve truncation notices and source links when passing the packet to an agent.

Docs: https://github.com/the-media-vampire/veyrul-integrations/tree/main/examples/n8n-media-research
